Title: Azure SQL Database managed instance business critical tier

Body.Content:
The business critical performance tier will be available for Azure SQL Database Managed Instance, effective December 1, 2018. Designed for mission-critical business apps with high I/O requirements, business critical supports high availability with the highest level of storage and compute redundancy.

Save up to 80 percent off the license-included full price when you apply Azure Hybrid Benefit for SQL Server and reserved capacity pricing.
